meta.name: Debian Rescue OS (Surface)
meta.target: Surface Pro 8 — fallback partition nvme0n1p6 (5GB, label=rescue-os-debian)
meta.purpose: Minimal CLI rescue OS with Node + Claude Code + on-demand X11 browser for OAuth

apt._linux_surface_repo: added in chroot-setup.sh before kernel install: https://pkg.surfacelinux.com/debian

services.note_systemd_networkd: Ships as part of the 'systemd' apt package in trixie — no separate install. NetworkManager owns interfaces by default; systemd-networkd is masked. To switch: systemctl unmask systemd-networkd && systemctl enable --now systemd-networkd && systemctl disable --now NetworkManager

_pool_removal_2026-05-15: Declarative mount of the NixOS LUKS pool from rescue-os-debian was REMOVED on 2026-05-15. Hosting the pool's crypttab/fstab here (even with noauto) made it one cryptsetup-open + mount away from out-of-band modification — the exact attack surface that contributed to the 2026-05-15 pool corruption (an out-of-band mount between hibernate-save and hibernate-resume can produce ghost commits the resumed kernel writes over). If you ever genuinely need to mount the pool from this rescue OS for forensics, do it as a one-shot manual cryptsetup-open + mount-ro — NEVER auto/persistent. See: incident_2026-05-15_pool_hibernate_corruption.md
install_order: 1. From Kali: bootstrap/install-debian.sh (mkfs p6, debootstrap trixie, install kernel/packages, write fstab, drop kernel to ESP, add refind stanza)
2. Reboot, select 'Debian Rescue OS' in rEFInd
4. Inside Debian: ./install.sh install (installs Node + Claude Code + any remaining tools)
5. ./install.sh browser (one-shot Firefox via xinit for Claude OAuth)
